_comment: GAP-1488: config writes over the pre-1.0.4 default preset (legacy). cli/tests/test_config_writer.py applies each case's writes with the config writer and checks the written admission block and the Python verdicts; internal/policy compiles the same admission block in Go. verdicts are for one MCP finding of that severity. live_edits: the same over the other write paths (policy edit actions/scanner, TUI Setup rows) that save through Config.save; cli are policy command arguments (run with --no-reload), tui are Setup rows. chosen: blocks a 1.0.4 command chose with the old preset's shape (policy activate of a named policy with the 1.0.3 default actions, saved as mine, or a write that made the shape from another block, base); they compile as written.

cases.name: defaults HIGH set to the quarantine shorthand
defaults HIGH set to the preset's own triple
MCP MEDIUM set to the preset's quarantine as a shorthand
MCP LOW set to the preset's own triple
all three set to the preset's own values
the whole MCP action map set

live_edits.name: policy edit actions HIGH --file quarantine (the preset's own value)
policy edit actions HIGH --install block (the preset's own value)
policy edit actions HIGH --runtime disable (the preset's own value)
policy edit actions MEDIUM --install block (MCP keeps its own MEDIUM)
policy edit scanner mcp HIGH --file quarantine
policy edit scanner mcp MEDIUM --file quarantine (the preset's own value)
policy edit scanner mcp LOW --runtime disable (the preset's own value)
policy edit scanner skill HIGH --install block

chosen.name: policy activate of a named policy with the 1.0.3 default actions, on a config with no admission
policy activate of a named policy with the 1.0.3 default actions, over the upgraded 1.0.3 default
config unset admission.mcp.actions.high leaves the old shape
config set admission.defaults.scan_on_install true makes the old shape
policy edit scanner --type mcp --severity high --remove leaves the old shape
TUI Setup row admission.mcp.actions.medium quarantine makes the old shape
TUI Setup row admission.defaults.allow_list_bypass_scan on makes the old shape
